records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue decreased for the year ended December 31, 2020 by $1,332 million, or 45.1%, when compared to the corresponding period of 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price of Hot-Rolled Coil declined 7.4% (from $620.53 per short ton to $574.67 per short ton) in 2020 compared to 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The price for WTI crude was $52.28 per barrel at January 22, 2021, up 33.3% from the 2020 average.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price of WTI crude declined 31.2% (from $56.98 per barrel to $39.23 per barrel), and natural gas prices declined 20.6% (from $2.57 per MMBtu to $2.04 per MMBtu) in 2020 compared to 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2020, operating loss was $420 million compared to operating loss of $83 million for the corresponding period of 2019.
